title: Case Bravo Digital Forensics #1
text: Case Alpha identifies Alex Morgan as a primary suspect. Alex Morgan used the iPhone 14 during the surveillance window. Riley Stone was seated at the same table when the iPhone 14 was seized, but Riley Stone never used the iPhone 14 and had no access to it.

title: Case Bravo Digital Forensics #2
text: The Samsung Galaxy S21 contained WhatsApp message logs recovered from the handset. During review, analysts stressed that it is not true that the iPhone 14 contained Signal; the original note claiming otherwise was retracted.

title: Case Bravo Digital Forensics #3
text: Cloud Backup contained Telegram exports tied to the case. Persona A controlled the Signal account that recurred across the messages. Investigators noted that although Signal traffic was discussed, the Cloud Backup did not contain Signal data of any kind.

title: Case Bravo Digital Forensics #4
text: Conversation Thread 17 mentioned Harbor Cafe as the planned meeting point. Alex Morgan participated in Conversation Thread 17, and Riley Stone participated in Conversation Thread 17 as well. The Blue Sedan was observed at Harbor Cafe later that night. Alex Morgan was never placed at Harbor Cafe in person.
